method: Compare distinct supported purchase mechanisms by billing counterparty, charge unit, cancellation/refund policy and evidence. Price examples are entries from official published country-level price schedules, not scraped channel-level offers or currency conversions.
population: Eligible YouTube viewers considering paid channel memberships, Supers or external Shopping links; not an observed purchaser sample

products.label: Channel memberships
products.buyer_action: Viewer chooses an enabled channel membership level and signs up through the supported purchase flow.
products.price_rule: Country-specific official membership price options; price and legacy tier may vary by signup date. A channel's displayed member price must be verified directly.
products.refund_rule: Cancellation stops future charges; unused portion normally not refunded. Problems or unauthorized charges have a support route; Apple-billed buyers use Apple refund policy.

products.label: Super Chat, Stickers and Thanks
products.buyer_action: Viewer initiates a paid on-platform support interaction where eligible.
products.price_rule: Chosen purchase values depend on feature, region and platform; not a standard channel-listing price.
products.refund_rule: Voluntary payments described as non-refundable. An unauthorized charge may be reported.

products.label: Shopping links to a retailer or marketplace
products.buyer_action: Viewer follows a retailer or marketplace offering and completes purchase under that seller's terms.
products.price_rule: Merchant sets final price and applicable charges; a displayed product price is not a universal YouTube creator price.
products.refund_rule: Retailer/marketplace handles order, support, returns and refunds for external checkout.

published_membership_price_examples.source_rollout_note: Price changes began rolling out in May 2025; timing and legacy prices can vary. Country schedules are not a sample of actual creator offers.
published_membership_price_examples.platform_scope: Published country price options only, not current price of any sampled creator's membership

buyer_flow_gates: Record actual country, device, billing provider, product, price tier and sign-up vintage before attributing an amount.
Separate YouTube-managed member charges from voluntary one-off Supers and purchases finalized by outside retailers.
Record taxes and app-store/billing fees only with transaction-specific evidence; do not assume the posted buyer price equals creator cash received.
Refundability is product- and processor-specific; buyer cancellation does not prove automatic refund.
A published tier is an offered option, not a representative market-price observation or platform-wide median.
Do not treat views and ad impressions as a viewer's direct purchase; YouTube advertising is a different payer path.
